documents.fileName: _RENEW HEALTH CENTER - FULL YEAR COMPARATIVE P&L (2024-2025).pdf
documents.intent: Extract and validate financial performance data from a comparative P&L statement for Renew Health Center LLC covering full years 2024 and 2025.
redFlags: Salaries & wages expense jumped 308% YoY ($48,470 to $198,422), with Ryan's Salary newly appearing at $76,500 in 2025
Payroll Expenses increased from $5,840 to $40,111 (587% increase)
Cash basis accounting may obscure accrual-basis liabilities, receivables, and working capital health
yellowFlags: Operating expense growth (47.5%) significantly outpaced revenue growth (74.5%)
Bank service charges doubled YoY ($10,528 to $18,236)
No detail provided on medical income composition

documents.intent: M&A financial due-diligence analysis of Renew Health Center using a completed financial modeling template.
redFlags: Negative IRR in both flat-case (-93.5%) and growth-case (-92.7%) scenarios
Adjusted EBITDA add-backs represent 64.5% of reported EBITDA (LTM)
Owner dependence (20–25 hours/week, performs clinical work) creates key-person risk
Regulatory/compliance concerns explicitly flagged: FDA warnings regarding regenerative medicine products
Complete balance sheet is missing (all assets, liabilities, equity blank for all periods)
yellowFlags: Flat-case MOIC of 1.00x combined with 1.48x DSCR leaves minimal margin for operational variance
Purchase price of $2.09M at 4.5x entry multiple assumes no multiple compression
